fixture_notice: Deterministic fictional product-discovery evidence created for an offline exercise.

product.name: Northstar Learning Hub
product.workflow_under_review: bulk employee import before launching a first learning cohort

decision_to_inform: Whether to fund guided CSV import recovery for the Q3 onboarding roadmap.
initial_hypothesis: First-time HR and L&D administrators at organizations with 50-499 employees fail to launch a first cohort within seven days because bulk-import validation shows generic errors and offers no repair path.
activation_definition: First learning cohort launched within seven calendar days of account creation.
research_questions: Where do first-time administrators stall before their first cohort launch?
Which import problems recur across interviews, support, and observed activation?
Does a guided repair flow improve unaided valid-import completion without admitting bad records?
Which solution is worth committing to for Q3?

theme_prioritization.intensity_score: mean intensity_1_to_5 among included interview observations

saturation_rule: Reached when no new coded theme appears in the final two completed target interviews and the leading pattern appears in at least three included interviews.

problem_validation_policy.note: Observed account data supports association, not causal attribution.

experiment_policy.primary_metric: valid import completed unaided within 15 minutes, intention-to-treat
experiment_policy.decision_rule: GO only when the problem is validated and the tested solution passes both the primary threshold and the guardrail; otherwise PIVOT or KILL.
